model_selection_clarification: Drift Baseline (Linear Momentum) achieved the lowest prediction error overall (RMSE 20.49, MAE 11.92). Ridge Regression (alpha=10.0) is the top-performing machine learning model (RMSE 21.03, MAE 12.76) and outperformed the Naive Persistence baseline (RMSE 22.02). best_model.joblib contains this selected ML pipeline for feature attribution and deployment. Drift Baseline predictions are preserved in evaluation tables for benchmark comparison.
evaluation_type: One-step-ahead historical evaluation on held-out test split
evaluation_limitation_note: One-step-ahead test evaluation uses actual historical lags from the preceding year. Multi-year forward recursive forecasts compound forecast errors across future horizons.
